Illinois Governor Pritzker Discloses Weight Loss and Drug Use

Illinois Governor J.B. Pritzker has publicly disclosed that he has lost 80 pounds and has been using a GLP-1 medication for weight loss. The disclosure comes amid questions about a potential presidential run.
